spike_verdict: Not fully carried: F15's 4.73 m/yr figure is a 2022 regional-erosion measurement, not a rate tied to the specific road, and it postdates the 2021 road closure it is credited with causing; the source (F19) calls the stretch the easiest route 'from most parts of the capital city' to the domestic terminal, not 'the only easy road to Trivandrum airport.' The page's own environment.mdx concedes exactly this ('that number describes the region... not a single fixed point') while the top-line SPIKE states it as a clean, unhedged causal fact.

blocking.claim: "Erosion measured at 4.73 meters a year swallowed the only easy road to Trivandrum airport, forcing passengers to walk in with their luggage."
blocking.problem: Overstatement on two axes. (1) Causal/temporal: the 4.73 m/yr rate is from a 2022 study describing 'the region including the Shankumugham beach' (F15), not a rate measured for this road segment, and it was published a year AFTER the road closed (F18, road closed ~April 2021; F15, study 2022). The page's own environment.mdx hedges this precisely ('That number describes the region... not a single fixed point'), but the spike states it as direct, unqualified cause-and-effect. (2) Scope: F19 says the closed stretch was 'the easiest route to reach the domestic terminal of the airport from most parts of the capital city' — not 'the only easy road,' and specific to the domestic terminal, not 'Trivandrum airport' generally.
blocking.evidence: F15 (Wikipedia, 2022 study): 'a study from 2022 found that the region including the shankumugham beach observed an erosion of 4.73 meters per year.' F19 (The News Minute, Sept 2021): 'a 500 metres stretch was closed, it was the easiest route to reach the domestic terminal of the airport from most parts of the capital city.' F18: road closed 'nearly five months ago' relative to the Sept 2021 report, i.e. ~April 2021 — before the 2022 study existed.
blocking.fix: Reword the spike to keep the tension without asserting the specific rate caused the specific closure, e.g.: "Erosion has already swallowed the easiest road to Trivandrum airport's domestic terminal, forcing passengers to walk in with their luggage — and a later study measured the coastline here retreating at 4.73 meters a year." Apply the same de-scoping ('the only easy road' → 'the easiest road') anywhere else the spike phrasing is repeated verbatim (spike_deep_explainer opening line, if present verbatim).
